title: The Big Sleep
author: Raymond Chandler
summary: A wealthy, ailing general hires private detective Philip Marlowe to deal with a blackmailer. The job leads to his two reckless daughters, a murdered man and a web of Los Angeles crooks.
readIf: you want the classic hard-boiled detective novel, with wisecracks and a tangled plot.
skipIf: you want a tidy plot, because even fans admit the story is hard to follow and dated in its attitudes.

pairings.reason: The other great American detective classic, with a sharper, colder lead and a famous object to chase.
A later Los Angeles detective novel that carries the tradition into a more realistic setting.
A futuristic noir that borrows the cynical detective and takes it into violent science fiction.
